abilities.name: Night's Sling

_curatorNotes: HYPERSENSE (A1, Nightshade Synesthesia) — re-homed here from the passive 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche), on Nahida's Tri-Karma shape. Where it was, it NEVER FIRED: `sim/procs.ts` arms a proc only from a resolved CAST ability or a summon, only with a non-empty `application[]`, and only with `armedFor` — the passive-hosted effect had none of the three. Measured before: `Ororon E Q > Xingqiu E Q > Fischl E` made four Electro-Charged reactions and zero Hypersense applications. gcsim `ororon/asc.go`: `hypersense(1.6, …)` queues an Electro hit at delay 12, Durability 25, ICDTagNone (so `icdGate: none`), behind a 1.8s status ICD (`procCooldown`). The EC/LC subscriptions carry NO actor filter, so his own reactions count too — `source: team`, not `others`.

⚠️ `armedFor: 15` APPROXIMATES a resource gate. In gcsim Hypersense spends 10 Nightsoul points, which he gains 5 at a time from teammates' Hydro/Electro hits for 15s after this skill (plus 40 per Nightsoul Burst, pool 80). The 15s window is where the points come from and his E cooldown is also 15s, so a played rotation keeps it armed; points banked past the window are not modelled. ⛔ The Nightsoul-aligned-DMG branch is still unmodelled (no primitive) — see the passive's notes.

3-bounce Spirit Orb (5 with C1 via c1ExtraBounce). Each bounce hits a separate enemy; not separately rendered (single E cast = single bar). The 15s post-skill window gates A1's Hydro/Electro Nightsoul-point gain — pure resource, not modelled.
abilities.description:
Ororon manifests an ancient mystical technique from the Masters of the Night-Wind as a Spirit Orb of midnight shade and throws it at his foe, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG.
When other opponents are nearby, the Spirit Orb will bounce between them, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG. Each time Night's Sling is used, each opponent can only be selected as a target once.
After 3 bounces, or if there are no eligible targets left, the Orb will disappear.

abilities.name: Dark Voices Echo

_curatorNotes: icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b): gcsim burst.go:88 sets ICDGroupOroronElementalBurst on the Soundwave Collision tick, whose table entry is a 180f reset window in which only the FIRST hit applies. Measured 3/9 applied, which standard also gives at this 60f interval — authored on the GROUP, since the coincidence does not survive a different cadence (and C4's 0.75× tick rate, unmodelled, is exactly such a cadence).
↻ 2026-08-18: split into two constellation-gated series. This is the C0 cadence — gcsim burstTick schedules at `60 * c4BurstInterval()` frames and c4BurstInterval returns 1.0 below C4.

⚓ THE C4 CADENCE. C4 reads "The Supersonic Oculus … rotates 25% faster", and gcsim burst.go schedules each tick at `int(60 * c4BurstInterval())` frames — the same expression drives the FIRST tick, so the delay from the summon’s 36f spawn moves with the interval.

⚠️⚠️ WE DIVERGE FROM gcsim HERE ON PURPOSE, BY 0.05s. `c4BurstInterval` returns a hardcoded **0.75**, i.e. an interval 25% SHORTER. The talent says 25% FASTER, which is a rate: ×1.25 speed is an interval of ÷1.25 = **0.8s** (48f), and the first tick lands 12f after the spawn. gcsim’s 0.75 is the common slip between "25% faster" and "25% less", and its value is a literal in the source rather than a measurement. ⚓ Authored to the kit text; ⚠️ this is a judgement, not a measurement, and it deserves an in-game check.

⚠️ The oracle cannot adjudicate it: `scripts/gcsim-dump` runs at C0, so §5 of the frames diff never reaches this branch. If the dumper ever gains constellation support this row will flag — which is the correct outcome, not a regression.

icdGate is unchanged — the group is a property of the attack, not of the rate. ⚓ Exactly what the base series’ own note predicted: it authored the group rather than the coincidence "because the coincidence does not survive a different cadence (and C4’s 0.75× tick rate, unmodelled, is exactly such a cadence)". It is modelled now, and the group carried over untouched.
⚠️ Left uncapped: gcsim stops when `supersonic-oculus` (540f from cast) lapses, which lands within a tick of our window walk. ⛔ A cap here would assert a boundary nobody measured.
effects.attribution: C4: Reverence for the Wondrous Wind (faster ticks)

_curatorNotes: Soundwave Collision DMG migrated to summons[0].effects[] (P3): gcsim burstTickHitmark=60f (=1s); first tick at 60f from cast = 24f after summon spawn (=0.4s firstTickDelay). Multiplier soundwave at TalentLvl 10 = 59.76% ATK Electro.

↻ 2026-08-18: the last sentence of the note above USED to read "C4 0.75× interval not authored as a constellationScaling on the trigger — schema currently doesn't support tick-interval scaling". Both halves are dead. The C4 cadence IS authored, as a SECOND constellation-gated summonTick series on this same summon (summons[0].effects[1], 0.8s — deliberately NOT gcsim's 0.75s; read that series' own notes before touching it). And the shape is deliberately NOT a scaling on the trigger: a cadence change is authored as two mutually-exclusive series because the rate is not the only thing that moves (Aino's ICD group and tick count change with hers), so the two series carry their own icdGate/firstTickDelay independently. ⚠️ Gating drops only a DEFINITIVE false — a reader with no constellation context fires BOTH series.

Supersonic Oculus is stationary in-game — placed on the player's location at burst cast and stays there. mobility: "stationary" matches; gcsim's burstArea is captured at frame 0 and reused for all ticks.
[A7] Taunt is surfaced only via the taunt tag as a placeholder; no dedicated taunt behavior is modeled.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The Supersonic Oculus draws a 9s summon bar with its damage tick marks and all of that is correct; aggro/positioning has no representation anywhere in the timeline, so nothing on screen is wrong or missing. The 'taunt' tag is a Team Builder capability label, and caveats never reach the Team Builder (rubric N17). Category: invisible-omission.

passives.name: Nightshade Synesthesia
_curatorNotes: ↻ MOVED 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche): the Hypersense damage effect now lives on the skill (`ororon__skill__nights_sling.effects[0]`) as a cast-armed `onReaction` proc with its own `application[]`. Authored here it reached no surface at all — no proc path reads a passive. Read that effect's notes for the source and the approximation.

Also gates 6s Nightsoul Blessing state on Ororon (10 NS consumed per trigger), but Ororon's Nightsoul state doesn't open any in-stance ability variant — so the state isn't authored on the schema. The Nightsoul resource flow (40 NS on Nightsoul Burst, 5 NS per teammate Hydro/Electro hit, max 80 pool) is internal accounting and not modelled per the constitution.
Nightsoul-aligned trigger (any teammate's Nightsoul-tagged DMG → Hypersense) isn't modelled — the schema doesn't have an 'onNightsoulHit' trigger primitive.
passives.description:
After a nearby party member triggers Nightsoul Burst, Ororon will gain 40 Nightsoul points. Within 15s after using his Elemental Skill, when other party members' Hydro or Electro attacks hit opponents, Ororon will gain 5 Nightsoul points, an effect that can occur every 0.3s for a maximum of 10 times during this 15s duration.
Ororon can have a maximum of 80 Nightsoul points.

Also, when nearby opponents take Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reaction DMG or Nightsoul-aligned DMG dealt by other nearby characters, Ororon will consume 10 Nightsoul points (provided he has at least that amount), entering the Nightsoul's Blessing state and triggering the Hypersense effect: Deal Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG based on 160% of Ororon's ATK to at most 4 nearby opponents. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 1.8s.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Ororon
Ororon's Nightsoul's Blessing state lasts 6s.

passives.name: Aspect Catalyst
_curatorNotes: Aspect Sigil: 15s window after Spirit Orb hits. Within window, active char's N/C/P hit grants 3 Energy to active + 3 to Ororon (if off-field), 1s ICD, max 3 procs. Not modelled — combination of post-skill state, active-char-hit gating, and proc-count cap isn't expressible in the schema. Energy generation as a buff effect would over-fire (~5x).

Caveat added 2026-07-28 (capability sweep). Confirmed base-kit flat Energy (not particles) per gcsim: skill.go:63 attaches makeA4cb to the Spirit Orb hit; asc.go:206-211 opens the 15s a4Key window; asc.go:162-199 AddEnergy(3) to active + AddEnergy(3) to off-field Ororon, 1s ICD, 3-proc cap. Energy effects have no onHit dispatch and maxProcs is an unbuilt P4 primitive, so the energy capability legitimately stays first-derivable at C4.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — There is no energy meter, energy lane or energy number anywhere in the planner — burst bars are placed by cooldown alone — so an unmodelled energy refund changes no rendered thing. Ororon's own C4 authors an `energy` effect that is equally inert and carries no caveat. Category: invisible-omission.
passives.description:
After the Elemental Skill Night's Sling's Spirit Orb hits an opponent, Ororon will gain the Aspect Sigil effect for 15s.

Aspect Sigil
When a nearby active party member hits an opponent with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, that character will restore 3 Energy. If Ororon is off-field, Ororon will also restore 3 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 1s, and can trigger 3 times per duration.

notModeled.reason: We don't track energy, so the planner doesn't draw the Energy this restores.

constellations.name: Trails Amidst the Forest Fog
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) +2 Spirit Orb bounces — not modellable as a structural ability change in the schema; (2) Nighttide debuff on hit, +50% Hypersense DMG vs Nighttide-affected enemies, 12s — would need a per-enemy state, which we don't model. Description-only.
constellations.description:
The Elemental Skill Night's Sling's Spirit Orb can bounce 2 additional times.
Additionally, after the Spirit Orb hits an opponent, it will apply the Nighttide effect to them for 12s. Opponents affected by Nighttide take 50% increased DMG from Hypersense triggered by the Ascension Talent, "Nightshade Synesthesia." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."

notModeled.reason: We don't draw damage amounts, and Nighttide only raises how hard Hypersense hits. The extra bounces need more opponents than the one we model.

constellations.name: King Bee of the Hidden Honeyed Wine
_curatorNotes: Spiritual Supersense: 8% base Electro DMG + per-Q-hit-stacked +8% (max +32%, so 40% total max). Modelled as a single 40% Electro DMG buff (max-stacks scenario). Per-stack accumulation across Q hits isn't expressible cleanly without adding a new stacks-on-hit primitive. Removed prior placeholder 8/8/32 split that wasn't reading sensibly.
constellations.description:

Additionally, during this time, every additional opponent hit by the Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo or Supersonic Oculus will grant Ororon a further 8% Electro DMG Bonus. The maximum that can be gained this way is 32% Electro DMG Bonus.

constellations.name: As the Mysteries of the Night Wind
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) +25% Supersonic Oculus rotation speed — a faster tick cadence on the burst's Supersonic Oculus. (2) +8 Energy to Ororon on Q cast — modelled as the energy effect on this entry.

↻ 2026-08-18: half (1) is MODELLED now, and the note above used to say otherwise ("1s → 0.75s interval; not modelled (we don't render per-tick emission)… roughly 25% more burst-tick damage which we can't render"). Two corrections. (a) It is authored — burst summons[0].effects[1] is a second summonTick series gated `constellation: 4`, with the C0 series gated `not constellation: 4`; the pair is mutually exclusive. (b) The interval is **0.8s, not 0.75s** — the C4 series deliberately diverges from gcsim's hardcoded 0.75 because "25% faster" is a RATE (÷1.25 = 0.8s). ⛔ Do not re-introduce 0.75 here; the reasoning lives on that series' notes.

↻ Also dead in the old note: "we don't render per-tick emission". Per-tick markers ARE drawn — finalize stamps TimelineWindow.ticks and the summon-lane projection reads them, so the marks a reader counts and the ticks that fire are one computation. ⚠️ The Team Builder's Compare lane is the surface that still lags: it takes the FIRST authored damage series and never consults effect `conditions`, so Ororon always shows the C0 1s cadence there regardless of the con lens. Damage MAGNITUDE remains unrendered site-wide, which is a constitution rule, not a gap.

constellations.name: Ode to Deep Springs
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) Q triggers a free Hypersense at 200% damage — could be modelled as an onCast/burst damage effect (320% ATK Electro), but only fires when A1 is unlocked AND uses Hypersense's hypersense() handler in gcsim. Skipped for cleanness; the additional damage event lives inside a complex precondition chain. (2) Per-Hypersense ATK +10% to active char, 9s, max 3 stacks — proc-stacked buff dependent on Hypersense triggering, not modellable cleanly. Description-only.
constellations.description:
After triggering Hypersense through the Ascension Talent, Nightshade Synesthesia, your current active character's ATK is increased by 10% for 9s. Max 3 stacks, each stack is counted independently.
Additionally, when you use the Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo, you will trigger one instance of an effect equivalent to Hypersense, dealing 200% of its original DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."
